title: Seaside Stranger: Harukaze no Étranger
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Novelist Shun left his Hokkaido hometown after his parents disowned him for being gay, a coming-out that also ended an arranged marriage to a childhood friend. Now living with his younger boyfriend Mio on a small island near Okinawa, Shun learns his father is ill and returns home with Mio, who lost his own parents and fears he may not be accepted by Shun's.
life_message: Love that is honest about who you are can reconcile estranged families, though acceptance takes time and courage.
